methods.name: Per Day
methods.description: Charge multiplied by number of days (quantity = days in bill)

methods.description: Charge multiplied by number of hours

methods.name: Per Minute
methods.description: Charge multiplied by number of minutes (e.g. C-Arm, OT time)

methods.name: Per Procedure
methods.description: Fixed charge per procedure regardless of time

methods.name: Per Quantity
methods.description: Charge multiplied by quantity column in bill

methods.description: Service is only applicable for outpatients / Day Care; ignore for IP rows

methods.description: No cap on quantity; billed as a single line
